sentences.en: Reproduction is asexual when there is no fusion of gametes.
sentences.zh: 1. 当配子不发生融合时，繁殖是无性生殖。

sentences.en: Interspecies aggression is oriented towards goals related to reproduction.
sentences.zh: 2. 种间攻击的目标与繁殖相关。

sentences.en: Cells have two methods of reproduction: mitosis and meiosis.
sentences.zh: 3. 细胞有两种繁殖方式：有丝分裂和减数分裂。

senses.zh: 生殖，繁殖；复印，再版；（声音的）复制，录制；复制品，仿制品
